title: Snap-fit enclosure
description: An injection-moulded enclosure for a 100 x 70 mm circuit board: a matt white ABS base and a translucent smoke-grey polycarbonate lid, closed by four external U-shaped snap latches, both parts moulded in straight-pull tools without slides.
process: Injection moulding, two straight-pull tools without slides

difficulty.rationale: Two drafted shells, straight-pull U-latches with a stepped parting line and their own tooling proofs, about 110 coupled formulas, closed-form sections, and kernel and measure limits to work around.

standards: USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification, Release 2.5 (USB-IF, 2026)
materials: FR-4 circuit board with a USB-C receptacle

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: walls 2.000 mm, latch strain 1.428 %, forces 1.685 / 2.553 N, crush 0.160 mm, drafts 1.5 / 1 / ½° as this example's; masses within 0.4 %; tooling columns clear, core steel over 1 mm; 20 assertions pass at six parameter corners. About 325 steps.
